# Replit

- [Features (220 pages)](https://docs.replit.com/_llms/en/features.md): Documentation for Features.

## Home

### Get started

- [Welcome to Replit](https://docs.replit.com/welcome.md): Learn how Replit turns ideas, everyday work, and intelligence into useful outcomes.

### Your journey

- [Get started](https://docs.replit.com/home/get-started.md): Follow a coffee shop launch from an early idea to a published opening site with Replit.
- [Understand your workspace](https://docs.replit.com/home/understand-your-workspace.md): Understand how your Replit Workspace brings together people, Projects, chats, Routines, data, integrations, and security.
- [Start a chat](https://docs.replit.com/home/start-a-conversation.md): Start a chat with a simple question, web research, or connected context, then choose what to do next.
- [Describe your idea](https://docs.replit.com/home/describe-your-idea.md): Use a chat to turn an early coffee shop idea into a focused concept and launch questions.
- [Integrations](https://docs.replit.com/home/integrations.md): Connect your tools, add reusable Skills, and extend Replit with MCP.
- [Integrate tools](https://docs.replit.com/home/integrate-tools.md): Connect the files and tools that give Replit the context to build a coffee shop launch plan.
- [Watch the competition](https://docs.replit.com/home/watch-the-competition.md): Create a weekly Routine that returns useful local research and launch-plan updates to your coffee shop chat.
- [Chats and projects](https://docs.replit.com/home/conversations-and-projects.md): Understand when to continue work in a chat and when to use a Project for substantial build or design work.
- [Design an opening site](https://docs.replit.com/home/design-an-opening-site.md): Turn the coffee shop launch plan into a design for an opening-soon site.
- [Publish the site](https://docs.replit.com/home/publish-the-site.md): Publish a coffee shop opening site and share a public link for people to discover it.

### Contextual routes

- [Chats](https://docs.replit.com/home/conversations.md): Use chats to ask questions, run routines, and turn ideas or information into useful outcomes.
- [The prompt box](https://docs.replit.com/home/prompt-box.md): Understand how the prompt box brings together your request, context, interaction choices, and intended outcome.
- [Projects](https://docs.replit.com/home/projects.md): Understand how a Project brings together the code, data, and artifacts for substantial build and design work.
- [Routines](https://docs.replit.com/home/routines.md): Schedule recurring work from a chat and receive the results in the same thread.
- [Schedule a routine](https://docs.replit.com/schedule-a-routine.md): Turn a recurring job into a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back to you.
- [Cloud Services](https://docs.replit.com/category/cloud-services.md): Learn how to publish your Replit Apps and manage cloud storage and databases to build production-ready applications.
- [Replit Apps](https://docs.replit.com/category/replit-apps.md): Replit Apps help you transform your ideas into apps anyone can access, anywhere.
- [Google Authentication in Python and Flask](https://docs.replit.com/additional-resources/google-auth-in-flask.md): Learn how to implement Google OAuth authentication in a Flask app on Replit, including user login and Google Sheets API integration.
- [Streaming native graphics using VNC](https://docs.replit.com/additional-resources/streaming-native-graphics-vnc.md): Replit offers virtual network computing (VNC) functionality. VNC is a mature virtual desktop protocol that allows your Replit App to stream a native desktop to your web browser. This protocol allows native applications (developed in Python, Java, C++, etc.) to open desktop windows as they would on a…
- [Cloud Aug 2026 Pricing Updates](https://docs.replit.com/billing/aug-cloud-billing-updates.md)

## Chat

### Overview

- [Chat](https://docs.replit.com/chat/overview.md): Learn how Chat helps you explore ideas, add context, turn chats into Projects, and tailor Replit to your needs.

### Get started

- [Chats](https://docs.replit.com/chat/conversations.md): Use chats to ask questions, run routines, and turn ideas or information into useful outcomes.
- [Chats vs. Projects](https://docs.replit.com/chat/conversations-and-projects.md): Understand when to continue in a chat and when to turn substantial work into a Project.
- [Prompting](https://docs.replit.com/chat/prompting.md): Give Replit clear direction in a chat and refine the result with useful follow-up requests.

### Add more context

- [Add context](https://docs.replit.com/chat/add-context.md): Give Replit the relevant files, sources, connected tools, and existing work needed to understand a chat.
- [Integrate your tools](https://docs.replit.com/chat/integrate-your-tools.md): Connect supported services, identify the information or action a chat needs, and follow the authoritative integrations documentation for setup.
- [Upload and use files](https://docs.replit.com/chat/upload-and-use-files.md): Add relevant documents, spreadsheets, images, or screenshots to a chat and tell Replit how the information should support your request.
- [Work with Figma](https://docs.replit.com/chat/work-with-figma.md): Use a Figma frame as visual context, then follow the Replit Design import flow when you want to explore, refine, or build from it.

### Turn a chat into a project

- [Turn a chat into a project](https://docs.replit.com/chat/continue-or-create-a-project.md): Choose whether to continue in a chat or ask Replit to turn substantial build and design work into a Project.
- [Import an existing Project](https://docs.replit.com/chat/import-a-project.md): Bring existing code or design work into Replit, understand how importing differs from attaching a file, and continue in the resulting Project.
- [Use a design system](https://docs.replit.com/chat/use-a-design-system.md): Use a saved design system as context for colors, typography, spacing, and components when you want Replit to create consistent visual work.

### More capabilities

- [Create assets](https://docs.replit.com/chat/create-assets.md): Create images, video, vector graphics, animation, and audio assets, then follow the authoritative guides for each workflow.
- [Routines](https://docs.replit.com/chat/routines.md): Schedule recurring work from a chat and receive the results in the same thread.

### Customize Replit

- [Select the right Agent Mode](https://docs.replit.com/chat/agent-modes.md): Choose Free Mode, Power Mode, or Max Mode based on the work you want to do, the capability you need, and your available allowance or credits.
- [Get the most out of Free Mode](https://docs.replit.com/chat/free-mode.md): Learn how to get more from Free Mode for everyday chat, creation, and building.
- [Use intelligent model routing](https://docs.replit.com/chat/auto-mode.md): Let Replit select an appropriate model for each task, then choose a model manually only when you need that control.
- [Choose a model](https://docs.replit.com/chat/model-selector.md): Choose an available model and set its Effort when manual model selection is available for your mode and plan.
- [Voice Mode](https://docs.replit.com/chat/voice-mode.md): Speak your prompts to Agent instead of typing. Voice Mode transcribes what you say into the chat box so you can review and send it.

### Extend Replit

- [Connect through MCP](https://docs.replit.com/chat/connect-through-mcp.md): Understand how MCP extends Replit with trusted external tools and how compatible MCP clients can connect to the Replit MCP Server.
- [Use Skills](https://docs.replit.com/chat/agent-skills.md): Customize how Replit approaches repeatable work with reusable instructions and supporting material.
- [Custom Instructions](https://docs.replit.com/chat/custom-instructions.md): Set workspace-wide guidance that helps Replit follow your team's conventions across Projects and sessions.
- [Memories](https://docs.replit.com/chat/memories.md): Learn how Memories can help Replit retain useful context across chats and Projects.
- [Memories, Custom Instructions, and Skills](https://docs.replit.com/chat/memories-custom-instructions-and-skills.md): Understand when to use Memories, Custom Instructions, or Skills to help Replit work with the right context and guidance.

### Contextual routes

- [Connectors](https://docs.replit.com/chat/connectors.md): Learn what integrations Agent supports and how they activate automatically based on your prompts.

## Build

### Web

#### Quickstarts

- [Build your first app](https://docs.replit.com/build/your-first-app.md): Start from a prompt, build a small app with Agent in Free Mode, test it in Preview, and improve it with a focused follow-up.
- [Build and publish from a template](https://docs.replit.com/build/build-and-publish-from-template.md): Start from a Replit Design template, turn the selected frame into a functional website with Agent, test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.
- [Build with Free Mode](https://docs.replit.com/build/build-with-free-mode.md): Use your included Free Mode allowance to turn an idea into a working app, one focused step at a time.
- [Publish your app](https://docs.replit.com/build/publish-your-app.md): Choose release settings, publish your app, verify the live version, and monitor it after launch.

#### Build paths

- [Prototype a product idea](https://docs.replit.com/build/prototype-an-idea.md): Turn a product idea into a focused prototype, collaborate with others, and use feedback to decide what to build next.
- [Launch a landing page](https://docs.replit.com/build/landing-page.md): Build and publish a landing page with one clear offer, one call to action, and a working form that captures responses.
- [Build a Shopify storefront](https://docs.replit.com/build/ecommerce-store.md): Learn how to design and launch a custom Shopify storefront with Replit.
- [Create a dashboard from data](https://docs.replit.com/build/dashboard.md): Turn a public CSV, spreadsheet, database, warehouse connector, or API into a dashboard that answers a clear question.
- [Build a mobile app](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-app.md): Build a phone-first app with Agent, test it in a simulator and on your phone, and share it for feedback.

#### Grow your app

- [Add login](https://docs.replit.com/build/add-login.md): Let each Velocity customer sign in to see their own bookings and saved cars.
- [Add a database](https://docs.replit.com/build/add-database.md): Make Velocity's cars, availability, and reservations stick around after refresh, restart, and publish.
- [Add payments](https://docs.replit.com/build/add-payments.md): Take a refundable deposit when a customer reserves a Velocity car, then charge the balance on pickup.
- [Add integrations](https://docs.replit.com/build/add-integrations.md): Send every Velocity booking to the customer's Google Calendar.
- [Add a custom domain](https://docs.replit.com/build/add-custom-domain.md): Move Velocity from velocity.replit.app to velocityrentals.com.

#### Publish and operate

- [Purchase a domain](https://docs.replit.com/build/domain-purchasing.md): Learn how to purchase a domain and connect it to your published app directly from Replit.
- [Enable Feedback Widget](https://docs.replit.com/build/enable-feedback.md): Learn how to collect feedback from visitors on your published app.
- [Improve your app's SEO](https://docs.replit.com/build/improve-seo.md): Use Replit's SEO rating and Agent to make your published app rank higher in search engines.
- [Troubleshoot publishing](https://docs.replit.com/build/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose common issues when a Replit app works in Preview, fails to publish, or behaves differently at its public URL.

#### Connect & integrate

- [Use Agent Skills](https://docs.replit.com/build/use-agent-skills.md): Give Agent specialized knowledge with Agent Skills — attach one to a message, install one in your project, or start a project from one.
- [Connect via MCP](https://docs.replit.com/build/connect-via-mcp.md): Connect Replit Agent to external tools, data sources, and APIs through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — sign in to a pre-listed server or add a custom one.

#### Collaborate

- [Invite teammates](https://docs.replit.com/build/invite-teammates.md): Invite teammates to your project and build together — each person can start new threads with Agent while working on the same project.
- [Create a team workspace](https://docs.replit.com/build/create-a-team-workspace.md): Create a Team Workspace on Replit, invite members during setup, and manage who has access to your team's projects.

#### Import

- [Import from a provider](https://docs.replit.com/build/import-from-providers.md): Bring projects, code, and designs from another tool into Replit and continue building with Agent.

### Mobile

#### Quickstarts

- [Start your first mobile app](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-first-app.md): Build PixelGames, a retro-style game app, as a native iOS and Android app with Agent.
- [Preview and test on your phone](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-preview-testing.md): Test PixelGames on your own phone with Expo Go.

#### Publish for iOS

- [Set up your Apple Developer account](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-apple-account.md): Enroll in the Apple Developer Program before publishing to the App Store.
- [Upload your app to App Store Connect](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-upload-ios.md): Use Replit's Launch feature to build, sign, and upload your app to App Store Connect.
- [Beta test with TestFlight](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-testflight.md): Hand PixelGames to real testers with TestFlight, before it's public on the App Store.
- [Submit to the App Store](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-publish-ios.md): Complete the App Store listing and send PixelGames for Apple's review.

#### Add features and grow your app

- [Add login](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-login.md): Let players sign in to PixelGames using Clerk.
- [Add payments with RevenueCat](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-payments.md): Charge players for content in your app using RevenueCat.
- [Store images in your mobile app](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-store-images.md): Save profile photos and other images to App Storage, linked to each player.
- [Add haptics](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-haptics.md): Add haptic feedback to PixelGames' D-pad and buttons.
- [Use iOS native components](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-native-components.md): Use alerts, action sheets, SF Symbols, and more native iOS components in PixelGames.
- [Use the camera](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-camera.md): Let players take a profile photo in PixelGames.
- [Access contacts](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-contacts.md): Let players see which friends are already playing PixelGames.
- [Send push notifications](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-push-notifications.md): Notify players about new games and friend activity in PixelGames.
- [Collect reviews and ratings](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-collect-reviews.md): Prompt happy players to rate PixelGames using each store's native review prompt.

#### Design

- [Design your app](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-design.md): Use Design mode to shape how your app looks, screen by screen.
- [Generate an app icon](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-app-icon.md): Use Replit's built-in image generation to create PixelGames' app icon.
- [Generate App Store screenshots](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-store-screenshots.md): Use Replit's built-in image generation to create PixelGames' store screenshots.

#### Collaborate

- [Build PixelGames with a team](https://docs.replit.com/build/mobile-invite-team.md): Invite teammates to build PixelGames in parallel, each with their own Agent task.

## Design

### Replit Design

- [What is Replit Design](https://docs.replit.com/design/what-is-replit-design.md): Replit Design is a design suite to generate design frames from prompts, explore the AI's suggestions, and keep everything on brand with design systems.
- [Design vs. Build](https://docs.replit.com/design/design-vs-build.md): Learn the difference between Design and Build in a Replit project, and when to start in each.

### Quickstart

- [Design your first screen](https://docs.replit.com/design/design-your-first-screen.md): Generate your first design frames from a prompt on Replit Design, explore the AI's suggestions, and keep iterating, no design experience needed.
- [Start from a template](https://docs.replit.com/design/start-from-a-template.md): Remix a featured template into a project of your own, open it in Replit Design, and restyle it until it's yours.
- [Import Figma designs into Replit Design](https://docs.replit.com/design/import-figma-designs-into-replit-design.md): Import a Figma frame into Replit Design, refine it with suggestions and chat, and build it into an interactive app.
- [Import Claude designs into Replit Design](https://docs.replit.com/design/import-claude-designs-into-replit-design.md): Send a design from Claude to Replit, create a project from the static HTML, and let Agent turn it into an interactive app.
- [Import a website into Replit Design](https://docs.replit.com/design/import-a-website-into-replit-design.md): Recreate a live website as a design frame in Replit Design, then refine it with suggestions and chat, and build it into an app.

### Core components

- [Replit Design components](https://docs.replit.com/design/core-components.md): Meet the building blocks of Replit Design: Canvas, frames, elements, chat, ambient intelligence, the toolbar, and the library panel, and how they fit together.
- [Canvas](https://docs.replit.com/design/canvas.md): Open, navigate, and add to the canvas, the infinite surface where Replit Design displays your frames.
- [Frames](https://docs.replit.com/design/frames.md): Frame kinds, the per-frame action bar, and the Build and Focus actions on Canvas.
- [Elements](https://docs.replit.com/design/elements.md): Select and edit the individual pieces inside a frame on Canvas.
- [Toolbar](https://docs.replit.com/design/toolbar.md): Reference for the Canvas toolbar: Interact, Pan, Chat, Draw, Edit, and Generate.
- [Library panel](https://docs.replit.com/design/library-panel.md): Reference for the library panel: add starter templates to your design, browse Mobbin-curated inspiration, and reuse your own creations.

### Explore

- [Explore](https://docs.replit.com/design/explore.md): Go wide before you commit: follow suggestions, pull in templates and inspiration, and switch models, all landing as new frames.
- [Explore suggestions](https://docs.replit.com/design/explore-suggestions.md): Select a design frame and Replit Design suggests what to design next; one click generates a new direction, and the winner can be applied to your app.
- [Explore with different models](https://docs.replit.com/design/explore-with-different-models.md): Switch the model behind Replit Design to explore different directions: each model brings its own design sensibility and frontend strengths.
- [Add templates and inspiration to your design](https://docs.replit.com/design/add-templates-and-inspiration.md): Use the library panel to add starter templates to your design, or pull in Mobbin-curated app screens as visual reference while you explore.

### Refine

- [Refine](https://docs.replit.com/design/refine.md): Shape the winning frame with precision: chat with Agent in your own words, or adjust elements directly with the Visual Editor.
- [Chat about your design](https://docs.replit.com/design/chat-about-your-design.md): Chat with Agent about your design, from the main chat with a frame attached or with the Chat tool aimed at a single element.
- [Visual Editor](https://docs.replit.com/design/visual-editor.md): Make direct visual edits to your designs and apps — adjust text, colors, layout, and images by clicking, without writing code.

### Build

- [Build your design](https://docs.replit.com/design/build-your-design.md): Turn the winning frame into real software: build it as a new app, or apply its look to an app you already have.

### Design systems

- [Design systems, explained](https://docs.replit.com/design/design-systems-explained.md): A design system captures your tokens, colors, typography, and components so every design you generate stays on brand.
- [Create a design system](https://docs.replit.com/design/create-a-design-system.md): Create a design system from scratch with a prompt, or extract one from a mockup you already like — then save it to your workspace.
- [Design system contents and DESIGN.md](https://docs.replit.com/design/design-md.md): What a generated design system contains — tokens, colors, typography, components — and how DESIGN.md represents it in your project.
- [Apply a design system to an existing app](https://docs.replit.com/design/apply-design-system.md): Rebuild an existing artifact under your design system — from the canvas or the composer — and what the time and credits warning means.

## Use cases

- [Use cases](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases.md): Browse workflows that bring your context, connected tools, and an outcome together in Replit.

### Research & analyze

- [Prepare for a customer call](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/prepare-for-a-customer-call.md): Research a question across connected tools, compare the evidence, and prepare a clear answer.
- [Analyze customer feedback](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/analyze-customer-feedback.md): Turn support tickets into themes, trends, and a dashboard the team can act on.
- [Monitor brand mentions](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/monitor-brand-mentions.md): Catch important conversations about your brand and send them where the team already works.
- [Monitor competitors](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/monitor-competitors.md): Detect pricing and feature changes, then keep a competitive intel page up to date.
- [Monitor top ads](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/monitor-top-ads.md): Centralize ad performance and see which creatives actually pay off.

### Operations

- [Generate a weekly sales report](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/weekly-pipeline-report.md): Show sales pipeline changes and trends from HubSpot every week.
- [Track subscriptions](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/track-subscriptions.md): Find recurring payments in email and calculate what they cost each month.
- [Catch up while away](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/catch-up-while-away.md): Turn Slack, email, and calendar into a return-to-work briefing.
- [Source candidates](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/source-candidates.md): From a job description, find matching engineers on GitHub, skip anyone already in Ashby, and draft outreach.
- [Generate release notes](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/generate-release-notes.md): Every week, turn GitHub and Linear changes into release notes people can actually read.

### Create & publish

- [Build an investor pitch deck](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/pitch-deck-from-website.md): From your site, Drive, and a finance Sheet, generate a 10–12 slide investor deck.
- [Create social icons and banners](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/create-social-kit.md): From your site and Drive, generate profile icons and cover banners for every network, in the right size.
- [Design a landing page](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/design-landing-page.md): From a Notion brief and brand files, design a waitlist or launch page in Replit Design.
- [Go from Figma to a live App](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/import-figma-design.md): Turn Figma frames into a publishable Replit app that matches layout, type, and color.
- [Build an online store](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/build-online-store.md): Import your catalog into Shopify and design the storefront in Replit.
- [Build a live API dashboard](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/live-api-dashboard.md): Turn a public API into a dashboard that stays up to date.
- [Launch a paid event website](https://docs.replit.com/use-cases/launch-event-website.md): Ship a program, speakers, venue, and paid tickets from Notion.

## Learn

### Foundations

- [What is an app?](https://docs.replit.com/learn/foundations/what-is-an-app.md): Learn what apps are, why they are useful, and how apps relate to the artifacts you can build and publish on Replit.
- [Introduction to AI](https://docs.replit.com/learn/foundations/introduction-to-ai.md): Learn the practical AI concepts behind Replit Agent — large language models, tokens, variability — and how AI agents combine models with tools to build with you.
- [Context management](https://docs.replit.com/learn/foundations/context-management.md): Learn how context windows work and how to give AI the right information when building with Replit Agent.
- [Vibe coding 101](https://docs.replit.com/learn/foundations/vibe-coding-101.md): Learn the mindset for vibe coding: start with a goal, build in small slices, manage context, review results, and improve with feedback.

### Projects & Artifacts

- [Project Editor](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/project-editor.md): Learn what the Project Editor is: your home base on Replit where you talk to Agent, see your app take shape, and manage everything.
- [Projects & Artifacts](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/projects-and-artifacts.md): Learn what projects and artifacts are on Replit, and decide when to keep artifacts in one project or create separate projects.
- [Storage and Databases](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/storage-and-databases.md): Learn about file storage and database options on Replit.
- [Auth](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/auth.md): Learn what Auth is on Replit — how user accounts let your app save preferences, gate features, and personalize the experience, and how to choose between Replit Auth and Clerk Auth.
- [Version control](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/version-control.md): Learn how to track changes and manage your code's history with Replit's version control tools.
- [Publishing](https://docs.replit.com/learn/projects-and-artifacts/replit-deployments.md): Share your Replit Apps with the world in just a few clicks.

### Work with Agent

- [Build with Agent](https://docs.replit.com/learn/build-with-agent.md): Learn five practical habits for working with Agent: be specific, plan the work, add context, review and test, and use checkpoints.
- [Plan vs. Build Mode](https://docs.replit.com/learn/plan-vs-build-mode.md): Learn the difference between Plan and Build modes in Replit, and how to combine them for more effective development.
- [Effective prompting with Replit AI](https://docs.replit.com/learn/effective-prompting.md): Learn principles and see examples for writing effective prompts when using Replit Agent.
- [Agent skills](https://docs.replit.com/learn/agent-skills.md): Understand when and how to use Agent Skills — proactive vs reactive patterns, being selective, security, and how skills differ from MCP servers.
- [Model Context Protocol](https://docs.replit.com/learn/model-context-protocol.md): Understand the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — what it is, how it works, and why it matters for AI applications.

### Power builder

- [Task system](https://docs.replit.com/core-concepts/agent/task-system.md): Agent breaks work into tasks you can review, run in the background, and apply back to your main version.
- [Build in parallel](https://docs.replit.com/learn/build-in-parallel.md): Learn how to build several features at once with parallel tasks: delegate safely, slice work small, and apply changes without surprises.

### Build safely

- [Development URLs](https://docs.replit.com/core-concepts/project-editor/app-setup/development-urls.md): Learn how to use development URLs to preview and share your in-progress app.
- [Security checklist](https://docs.replit.com/learn/security-checklist.md): Follow this comprehensive security checklist to ensure your vibe coded applications follow best security practices.

## Trust & Billing

### Billing

- [Billing](https://docs.replit.com/category/billing.md): Replit's billing system helps you optimize your spending on the platform.
- [Replit AI Billing](https://docs.replit.com/billing/ai-billing.md): Learn how billing and credits work for Replit AI features including Agent usage, checkpoints, and managing your spend.
- [Publishing costs](https://docs.replit.com/billing/deployment-pricing.md): Flexible publishing costs that scale with your app's needs. Pay only for what you use with transparent, credit-based billing.
- [App Storage Billing](https://docs.replit.com/billing/object-storage-billing.md): Learn how Replit charges for App Storage.
- [Publishing and Database Billing](https://docs.replit.com/billing/about-usage-based-billing.md): Learn how Replit bills for publishing and databases, including outbound data transfer, compute units, requests, and PostgreSQL usage metrics.
- [Managing Your Spend](https://docs.replit.com/billing/managing-spend.md): Control AI costs and monitor spending with usage limits, budgets, Plan Mode, and Agent modes. Learn strategies to optimize your Replit usage and reduce unnecessary token consumption.

### Plans

- [Starter Plan](https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/starter-plan.md): Learn about the Starter plan features, limitations, and what you can build for Free.
- [Replit Core](https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/replit-core.md): Learn about Replit Core membership features including powerful AI tools, high-performance development resources, and one-click publishing.
- [Replit Pro](https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/replit-pro.md): Learn about Replit Pro: our most powerful plan for serious teams—up to 15 builders, tiered credits with rollover, and priority support.
- [Replit Enterprise](https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/replit-enterprise.md): Replit Enterprise adds SSO/SCIM, governance, dedicated support, and unlimited seats. Upgrade from any plan without leaving Replit or contacting sales.
- [Changing your plan](https://docs.replit.com/billing/plans/changing-your-plan.md): Learn how to change your Replit plan, what happens when a plan change takes effect, and how to cancel a scheduled downgrade.

### Security

- [Legal and Security](https://docs.replit.com/category/legal-and-security.md): Learn about Replit's policies on security, privacy, usage limits, and other legal matters to help you use the platform safely and effectively.
- [Strike system FAQ](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/strike-system-faq.md): Learn about warnings, banned community access, and site bans in Replit.
- [Account Inactivity](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/account-inactivity.md): Learn about Replit's account inactivity policy, when accounts may be terminated, and how paid subscriptions affect account status.
- [Deleting your data](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/deleting-your-data.md): Learn how to permanently delete your account and personal information from Replit using either the web browser or mobile app.
- [Model improvement](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/model-improvement.md)
- [Security](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/security.md): Your code, applications, and data are important. We're committed to protecting them—Replit's security is our security, too.

Here's how you can help
- [Copyright claims and takedown requests](https://docs.replit.com/legal-and-security-info/copyright-claims-takedown-requests.md): Learn how to submit DMCA takedown requests for copyrighted content or private information on Replit Apps and understand the required documentation process.

## Enterprise

### Overview

- [Getting started](https://docs.replit.com/teams/welcome.md): Help your team turn ideas into outcomes: applications, designs, and slides. With the access controls, security, and governance controls your organization needs.

### Workspace Essentials

- [Create an account](https://docs.replit.com/teams/create-an-account.md): Get started with Replit Enterprise: create an account or sign in, choose the self-serve Enterprise plan, and complete signup before setting up your Workspace.
- [Create your Workspace](https://docs.replit.com/teams/create-your-workspace.md): Create a team Workspace in Replit Enterprise, then open its overview to review your new shared space and personalize its name and logo.
- [Configure single sign-on (SAML SSO)](https://docs.replit.com/teams/configure-saml-sso.md): Configure SAML single sign-on for Replit Enterprise: enable setup in Advanced settings, choose your identity provider, and complete your organization's configuration.
- [Add collaborators](https://docs.replit.com/teams/add-collaborators.md): Invite collaborators to your Replit Workspace: open Workspace collaborators, choose a Member, Guest, or Viewer role, and send invitations to multiple email addresses.
- [Manage connectors](https://docs.replit.com/replitai/managing-connectors.md): Set up and manage connectors on Core, Pro, and Enterprise plans. Centralized admin controls, scoped access, and audit tracking.
- [Groups and permissions](https://docs.replit.com/teams/groups-and-permissions.md): Create Enterprise groups, add collaborators, and configure Workspace, group, and app permissions so each team has the access it needs to work in Replit.
- [Privacy and deployment settings](https://docs.replit.com/teams/privacy-and-deployment-settings.md): Control how your team publishes applications, protects development previews, and selects deployment geographies with Enterprise privacy and deployment settings.
- [Agent modes and models](https://docs.replit.com/teams/modes-and-model-providers.md): Choose approved models for your Enterprise Workspaces and control access to fast model variants and higher reasoning effort levels.
- [Security](https://docs.replit.com/teams/security.md): Monitor Workspace vulnerabilities, prepare fixes with Replit, and configure account-wide security scans, Auto-Protect, and publishing severity policies.
- [Observability](https://docs.replit.com/teams/observability.md): Monitor Replit Enterprise usage across Workspaces, explore consumption by user, project, or resource, and review audit logs for security-relevant activity.
- [Standardization](https://docs.replit.com/teams/standardization.md): Standardize how your organization builds with reusable skills, remembered preferences, Workspace-wide instructions, and consistent design systems.
- [Advanced settings](https://docs.replit.com/teams/advanced-settings.md): Review account seats, use the Enterprise Admin API, and configure access requests alongside your organization's other administrative settings.

### Enterprise

- [Replit Pro and Enterprise](https://docs.replit.com/category/teams.md): Have your team build production-ready customer apps and business tools faster with Replit.
- [Information Security](https://docs.replit.com/teams/information-security/overview.md): Learn about Replit's security practices, data protection, and compliance standards
- [Source control settings](https://docs.replit.com/teams/enterprise-privacy-settings.md): Require Git remotes and private repositories for apps in your organization.

### Warehouse Connectors

- [Warehouse Connectors](https://docs.replit.com/connectors/warehouses/overview.md): Connect Replit Agent to data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake) and analytics platforms to build data-driven applications.
- [Databricks Connectors](https://docs.replit.com/connectors/warehouses/databricks.md): Choose and set up a Databricks connector so Replit Agent can build applications backed by your Databricks workspace.
- [Build Data Apps on Microsoft Fabric](https://docs.replit.com/connectors/warehouses/microsoft-fabric.md): Build and publish data apps on Microsoft Fabric with Replit Agent.
- [Snowflake Connectors](https://docs.replit.com/connectors/warehouses/snowflake.md): Set up a Snowflake connector to build data-driven applications with Replit Agent.

### Identity and Access Management

- [Managing Members](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/managing-members.md): You can manage members on your Replit team to control access, collaboration, and permissions across your organization's apps and projects.
- [Roles, Groups and Access](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/groups-and-permissions.md): Control member access with roles and groups. Roles provide default access levels (Admin, Member, Guest, Viewer), while custom groups—available exclusively on the Enterprise plan—offer fine-grained access control.
- [Account and Workspace Admins](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/account-and-workspace-admins.md): Account admins and workspace admins are distinct roles. Account admins manage billing and every workspace under your account, while workspace admins manage only the workspaces they belong to.
- [Access Management](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/repl-access-management.md): Learn how to control access and visibility settings for Replit Apps through the Project Editor interface, including group permissions and user roles.
- [Single sign-on (SAML SSO)](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/saml.md): Set up SAML single sign-on for your Replit Enterprise Organization directly from your workspace settings, including IdP configuration and email domain claims.
- [SCIM](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/scim.md): Set up SCIM to automate provisioning from your identity provider, then manage how synced groups map to your Replit workspaces, roles, and account admins.
- [Audit Logs](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/audit-logs.md): Track and monitor security-relevant actions in your Replit Enterprise organization with comprehensive audit logs and SIEM integration.
- [Compliance API](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/compliance-api.md): Retrieve retained customer prompt content to enrich Replit Enterprise audit logs for security and compliance workflows.
- [Viewer Seats](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/viewer-seats.md): Learn how to set up and manage viewer seats for your Replit Team.
- [Transfer App to Teams](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/transfer-app-to-teams.md): Move personal apps to team workspaces or projects between team workspaces
- [Manually copy a project to another workspace](https://docs.replit.com/teams/identity-and-access-management/manually-copy-projects.md): Copy a live app to another workspace or account by hand: copy the code, set up the new app, point your users at it with minimal downtime, and know how to undo it

### Billing for Enterprise

- [Overview](https://docs.replit.com/billing/teams-billing/overview.md): Learn about billing for organizations on Replit Pro, including tiered credits, pooled usage, and migration from the former Teams plan.
- [Managing Seats](https://docs.replit.com/billing/teams-billing/managing-seats.md): Learn how to add and remove seats in your organization, including prorated billing and scheduling changes for the next contracted period.
- [Analytics Dashboard](https://docs.replit.com/billing/teams-billing/analytics-dashboard.md): View activity, resource usage, published apps, and costs with the Enterprise Analytics Dashboard.
- [Cancellation](https://docs.replit.com/billing/teams-billing/cancellation.md): Learn how to cancel your organization subscription and understand what happens to your resources when you delete your organization.
